basics.name: Alexandra Okonkwo-Fitzgerald
basics.label: Principal Engineer, Platform & Infrastructure
basics.summary: Principal engineer with 14 years of experience designing distributed systems, developer platforms and data infrastructure at scale. Track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into durable platforms: built the internal deployment platform used by 900 engineers, led a multi-region active-active migration with zero customer-visible downtime, and grew two platform teams from scratch. Equally at home in a design review, an incident bridge or a hiring loop.

work.name: Helios Payments
work.summary: Technical lead for the core payments platform (ledger, risk, payouts) serving 3M merchants.
highlights: Defined the multi-year platform strategy adopted by the CTO staff; aligned 11 teams on a shared service mesh and golden paths
Led a multi-region active-active migration of the ledger (40 TB, 25k writes/s) with zero customer-visible downtime
Built the internal deployment platform used by 900 engineers, cutting median lead time for changes from 3 days to 40 minutes
Reduced cloud spend by 27% ($6.1M/year) through right-sizing, spot capacity and storage tiering
Created the incident-review programme and on-call standards; MTTR dropped from 94 to 31 minutes
Hired and grew two platform teams (14 engineers) and mentored 6 engineers to senior and staff levels
